name: talo-patello-scaphoid osteolysis
description: Talo-patello-scaphoid osteolysis is an extremely rare form of primary osteolysis, described in two sisters to date, characterized by bilateral osteolysis of the tali, scaphoids, and patellae (accompanied by periarticular swelling and pain) and short fourth metacarpals (brachydactyly type E), in the absence of renal disease. Autosomal recessive inheritance has been suggested.
